static_schedule: no ready/credit on on-die paths; GO + compiled gd per slice (role ROM); landing checked at release (fault); HBM boundary elastic per owner 10-15. S81U-SVC4: the p feed is compiled (GO frame PO: one step a cycle from PO; not landed = fault 20, engine refusal = fault 21; the engine p_ready is no longer looked at); the owners drain P.V in compiled 40-word windows from GO frame PVO + rs_pvslot(ST, sid) (beat not produced = fault 19); return-tree collisions are faults. Both entries must receive the q stream in the same cycle (die: q_W / q_E with equal station counts).
